clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! It been a long time since I seen you. Did you know that King Rastakhan himself be givin' me the order to add the final bit of mojo and magic to your talisman? It be true, mon! I wouldn't have believed it had I not seen it with me own eyes. Give it here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend mon, it been a good journey. Keep on with the killing and suppressing of Hakkar and he minions.
